content: Malagizo ga Musa hagaigalile kamba vigeli genyego, ni mbuli ndodo ziiyeka za vinhu vinogile vondavize. Nhosa zizija zigendelela kulavigwa mwaka mbaka mwaka. Kwa mbuli ayo, odaha vilihi kunoga wanhu waja omwizila Imulungu kubitila nhosa zino?
Maza kweli wanhu wano iwomtambikila Imulungu wahasunhigwe nzambi zao, sambi wagese kabili kamba watenda nzambi na nhosa zose zahamalile baho.
Lakini nhosa zolavigwa mwaka mbaka mwaka kuwatenda wanhu wakumbuke kamba wana nzambi,
kwavija damu ya mbuzi na ng'ombe haidaha bule kusegesa nzambi za wanhu.
Lekaavo, Yesu viyakalile mmabehi kwiza mwiisi, kamulongela Imulungu,

content.text: “Hulondile wanhu walave nhosa na kukugwaa nhunza,
kamba viyandikigwe mbuli yangu mna gamaandiko Gang'alile.’ ”

content: Tanhu kalonga, “Hulonda hebu hunogeligwa na nhosa na nhunza hebu wanyama wasomigwe muupango na nhosa za kusegesa nzambi.” Kalonga avo hata kamba nhosa zose zino zolavigwa kwa kukweleleza Malagizo ga Musa.
Abaho kalonga, “Niye nabaha, go Imulungu kusang'hana viulonda.” Avo Imulungu kasegesa nhosa zose za umwaka na hanhu hake kamwika Kilisito mwenyego kamba nhosa.
Kwavija Yesu Kilisito kasang'hana kija kiyalondile Imulungu, siye tosunhigwa nzambi kwa nhosa ya lukuli lwake yailavile mwanza umoja mbuli ya wose.
Kila mulava nhosa wa Kiyahudi kotenda sang'hano yake ya kulava nhosa kila siku na kolava nhosa zizija miyanza mingi, lakini nhosa azo hazidahile bule kusegesa nzambi.
Lakini Kilisito kalava nhosa imoja kwa nzambi, nhosa ilibule uhelelo, abaho kakala muukulu mwambu wa mkono wa kudila wa Imulungu.
Toka kipindi acho kobetela mbaka vonda wahumigwe wanhu wamwihile na wekigwe hasi mmagulu gake.
Kwa nhunza yake imoja, kawatenda watelele kipindi chose wanhu waja osunhigwa nzambi zao.

content: Abaho kolonga, “Honda nigese kabili nzambi zao na sang'hano zao zihile.”
Avo kamba nzambi zigeligwa kumgongo, hailondigwa nhosa kabili ya kusegesa nzambi za wanhu.
Tumkwesele behi Imulungu
Avo ndugu zangu, damu ya Yesu yotugela moyo wa kugangamala kwingila Mdigati Ding'alile Ng'hani.
Nayo katuvugulila nzila ya sambi, nzila itulongoza muugima kubitila panziya dija. Katenda avo kwa kululava lukuli lwake.
Avo tunayo Mulava nhosa Mkulu, mkulu wa ng'anda ya Imulungu.
Avo tumkwesele behi Imulungu kwa moyo unogile na kugangamala mna ditamanilo na mizoyo isunhigwe kulawa mna gamagesa gehile na ng'huli zisunhigwe kwa mazi mazelu.
Avo tolondigwa tudigoge ng'hani tamanilo jetu ditulonga kwa milomo yetu, kwavija ija ituilagane nayo kotamaniligwa.
Na tugese vitulondigwa kuigela moyo na kuinogela na kusang'hana ganogile.
Sikutuleke kuiting'hana, kamba wanhu wayagwe viwoleka kuiting'hana, ila tuigangamize ng'hani, kamba vimukona siku ija ya Mndewa yammabehi.
Twahagendelela kutenda nzambi giladi na kwavija tuujuwa ukweli, kuduhu nhosa isigale yonda ilavigwe kabili kusegesa nzambi za wanhu.
Lakini kisigale ni kubetela kwa bwembwe nhaguso yonda ize na moto mkali onda uwasakaze waja wose omulema Imulungu!
Kamba wanhu wabili hebu wadatu omulavila kitala munhu kwa kubena Malagizo ga Musa, munhu ayo kokomigwa bila koneligwa bazi.

Vino, yokuwa vilihi wanhu waja ombezeli Mwana wa Imulungu? Munhu iyogesa kamba kinhu kidodo damu ya lagano da Imulungu isunhile nzambi zake, munhu yomulonga vihile Loho wa Imulungu yotugwaa ng'hekewa. Geseni nhaguso yonda yaipate munhu ayo yobanza ukwiha!
Kwavija tomjuwa yalongile, “Niye ayo yonda nilihe gehile, mulihaji ayo niye,” na vivija kalonga, “Mndewa kowatagusa wanhu zake.”
Kinhu cha kudumba ng'hani kugogigwa na Imulungu na kutagusigwa!
Kumbukeni galawilile kumwenu baho umwaka vimugubuliligwe ukweli wa Imulungu, mugaya ng'hani lakini mugangamala.
Kuna kipindi muligigwa na kutendigwa vihile mgameso ga wanhu na kipindi kiyagwe muitanda kuilumba na wanhu waja wakalile otendeligwa mbuli zino.
Muwonela bazi wanhu wakalile mkifungo, na mutogola kwa kudeng'helela vimukalile mobokigwa vinhu venu, kwavija mukala mujuwile kuwa mna kinhu kinogile ng'hani, chonda kikale kipindi chose.
Avo sikumuleke kugangamala, kwavija kugangamala ako, kowagalila nhunza ng'hulu.
Molondigwa kufunga moyo ili mwahamambukiza kutenda goyolonda Imulungu, mubokele kija kiyalongile.
Kwavija Maandiko Gang'alile golonga,

content.text: Lakini munhu wangu yanogile mgameso gangu, kokala mwiisi kwa kutamanila,

content: Siye hatuigalile na wanhu waja obwela kuchugu na kunangigwa. Lakini togendelela kutamanila na kukomboligwa.
